# datadog_feature_flag_environment (Resource)

Manages a Datadog Feature Flags environment definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_feature_flag_environment" "production" {
  name                          = "Production"
  queries                       = ["env:production"]
  is_production                 = true
  require_feature_flag_approval = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable environment name.
- `queries` (List of String) Datadog tag queries that define the environment scope.

### Optional

- `is_production` (Boolean) Whether this is a production environment. Defaults to `false`.
- `require_feature_flag_approval` (Boolean) Whether feature flag changes in this environment require approval. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time the environment was created.
- `description` (String) Environment description returned by Datadog. The environment write API does not support changing it.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String) Server-generated environment key.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the environment was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_feature_flag_environment.production "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
```
